metric_scope: Spearman across source-averaged arm values within each source; displayed associations pool seven methods, including external algorithms. Conditional on this method menu, not independent image-level correlations.
conclusion: Dose predicts within-source perceptual-retention changes better than text alignment. Allocation gives small additional LPIPS prediction gains; memory indicators add information when BOTH is included. Absolute and within-source R84-to-R85 impulse-only linear transfer fails to outperform baseline. Linear allocation-adjusted regional transfer gives only modest positive skill (0.084). No universal dose collapse, pure localization causality, or 3-metric conflict claim.
